map.CSR 评分高是否等于社会贡献大？: Does a high CSR score mean a large social contribution?
map.CSR 项目立项前，按社会价值、利益相关方、传播策略、可持续性、评估体系 5 个: Before approving a CSR project, score each of five dimensions - social value, stakeholders, communication strategy, sustainability and evaluation system - from 0 to 5 to anticipate how solid the project is.
map.→ 打开CSR（项目/传播/评估）策划工具: -> Open the CSR (project / communication / evaluation) planning tool
map.为什么把「评估体系」单独列为维度？: Why is the evaluation system listed as a dimension of its own?
map.对企业社会责任(CSR)项目从项目设计、传播策略到效果评估进行全链路评分，涵盖社: End-to-end scoring of corporate social responsibility (CSR) projects from design and communication strategy through to effect evaluation, covering 5 dimensions: social value, stakeholders, communication strategy, sustainability and evaluation system.
map.很多 CSR 项目败在「做了没_measure」——有活动无数据，无法向监管、E: Many CSR projects fail at "did it, but no _measure" - activity without data, so nothing can be reported to regulators, ESG raters or the public. Making the evaluation system a dimension of its own forces the metrics, data definitions and third-party verification to be worked out at approval, so there is nothing to report at year end.
map.把多个 CSR 选题放一起评分排序，优先推进高分且贴合企业战略的项目。: Score and rank several CSR topics together, advancing the high-scoring projects that also fit corporate strategy.
map.评分高代表「设计维度均衡、可传播可延续」，但不等于绝对贡献大。本工具是立项前的质: A high score means the design is balanced, communicable and sustainable, but not that the absolute contribution is large. This tool is a quality yardstick for judging before approval; the real contribution shows up in quantifiable outcomes after delivery (people benefited, emissions avoided, jobs supported). An excellent score should be a signal that it is worth investing, not proof of results.
map.项目中期复盘时重评，看传播与可持续性两项是否跟上，避免「只做不说」或「一阵风」。: Re-score at the mid-project review to see whether communication and sustainability have kept up, avoiding a project that was done but not talked about, or that was a passing fad.
map.：5 个维度各 0~5 分：①社会价值 ②利益相关方（覆盖与参与）③传播策略 ④: : five dimensions scored 0-5 each: 1) social value, 2) stakeholders (coverage and participation), 3) communication strategy, 4) sustainability and 5) evaluation system. Total = sum of the five, maximum 25. Grades: 21 and above excellent, 17 and above good, 12 and above pass, below 12 fail.
map.：某乡村振兴项目 社会价值5+利益相关方4+传播5+可持续4+评估4 = 22: : a rural revitalisation project scores social value 5 + stakeholders 4 + communication 5 + sustainability 4 + evaluation 4 = 22, judged excellent (21 or above) and recommended for promotion. By contrast a token charitable donation scores social value 3 + stakeholders 3 + communication 2 + sustainability 2 + evaluation 3 = 13, judged a pass (12 or above), but the weak communication and sustainability scores suggest that "donating is easy, lasting mechanisms are weak", so communication and closed-loop evaluation need strengthening.
